import json,os,pathlib,statistics
import torch
from torch.nn import functional as F
from torch.nn.attention import sdpa_kernel,SDPBackend
from benchmarks.atlasfold.profile_inference import resolve_physical_device,_GpuProcessMonitor
from openfold3.core.model.layers.triangular_attention import TriangleAttention
import openfold3.core.model.primitives.attention as attention
root=pathlib.Path('/media/IntelSSD/fireprot');torch.cuda.init();device=resolve_physical_device();monitor=_GpuProcessMonitor(device['gpu'],os.getpid(),1);monitor.start()
state=torch.load('/media/PM982/engramfold/folding_e2e_20260921/weights/openbind0/of3-ob-2025-06-30-174k.pt',map_location='cpu',mmap=True,weights_only=True)
original=attention._attention
r={'device':device,'dtype':'float32','seed':1231,'chunk_size':128,'warmup':1,'repetitions':3,'cases':[],'scope':'Trained first-block triangle operators on synthetic activations and all-valid masks; no full-model speedup claim.'}
def candidate(q,k,v,biases,use_high_precision=False):
 assert not use_high_precision and q.dtype==torch.float32
 with sdpa_kernel(SDPBackend.EFFICIENT_ATTENTION):
  return F.scaled_dot_product_attention(q,k,v,attn_mask=biases[1],dropout_p=0.0,scale=1.0)
def timing(fn):
 fn();vals=[]
 for _ in range(3):
  a=torch.cuda.Event(enable_timing=True);b=torch.cuda.Event(enable_timing=True);a.record();fn();b.record();b.synchronize();vals.append(a.elapsed_time(b))
 return statistics.median(vals)
try:
 torch.backends.cuda.preferred_blas_library('cublas')
 with torch.inference_mode():
  for n in (1000,1536):
   torch.manual_seed(1231);z=torch.randn(1,n,n,128,device='cuda');mask=torch.ones(1,n,n,device='cuda')
   for kind in ('start','end'):
    mod=TriangleAttention(128,32,4,starting=kind=='start').cuda().eval();prefix=f'pairformer_stack.blocks.0.pair_stack.tri_att_{kind}.'
    mod.load_state_dict({k[len(prefix):]:v for k,v in state.items() if k.startswith(prefix)},strict=True)
    fn=lambda:mod(z,mask,chunk_size=128,inplace_safe=False)
    attention._attention=original;ref=fn();base=timing(fn)
    attention._attention=candidate;out=fn();fast=timing(fn)
    delta=(out-ref).abs();r['cases'].append({'length':n,'kind':kind,'native_ms':base,'sdpa_ms':fast,'exact':torch.equal(out,ref),'max_abs':float(delta.max()),'rms':float(delta.square().mean().sqrt()),'finite':bool(torch.isfinite(out).all())})
 r['status']='complete'
except BaseException as e:
 r['status']='failed';r['error']=repr(e);raise
finally:
 attention._attention=original;r['isolation']=monitor.stop();(root/'outputs/openfold3/sdpa-probe.json').write_text(json.dumps(r,indent=2));print(json.dumps(r),flush=True)
